title: MotionByDk AE Workflow Pro v3.8.0 Suite Released!
message: Major update with Official Signed ZXP, Auto-cleaner for duplicate legacy versions, and Native Liquid Glass auto-installer.
changelog: Official Adobe Signed ZXP Package compatible with aescripts + aeplugins ZXP Installer & Anastasiy Extension Manager
Smart in-app auto-cleaner: Automatically detects and wipes old duplicate versions from CEP extensions
Native Liquid Glass plugin (ToolsForMotion) auto-placed into After Effects Plug-ins directory
Cloudflare D1 Dynamic Activation Engine with real-time 2-PC device locker & Admin Panel sync
Dual-View Split Screen workspace, EaseCopy, and 6 curated motion designer themes
Universal support for Adobe After Effects CC 2019 through 2026+
